lore.spelunkery.saltpeter: A salty white crystal sifted from Spring Water with a Sluice. Mix it with Sulfur Dust and Charcoal to make Gunpowder.
lore.spelunkery.sulfur: A yellow powder crushed or milled from Sulfur stone. Mix it with Niter and Charcoal to make Gunpowder.
lore.spelunkery.salt: A pile of Salt. Lay it on the ground as a line the undead can't cross, or use it to cure Leather.
lore.spelunkery.salt_bucket: A bucket of Salt, made by boiling a Water Bucket in a Furnace. Place it to pour out Salt.
lore.spelunkery.salt_lamp: A warm lamp carved from Rock Salt.
lore.spelunkery.dust: Fluffy dust shaken loose from a Dust Bun.
lore.spelunkery.dust_bun: A ball of fluff left behind by Dust Bunnies. Use it to break it open.
lore.spelunkery.bunny_ears: A pair of fluffy ears that can be worn on your head.
lore.spelunkery.tangle_roots: Tough, tangled roots. Used to make Tangle Ladders.
lore.spelunkery.rope_ladder: A rope ladder that can be placed on the side of a block and unrolls downwards automatically, like scaffolding. Use it on the top ladder to roll it back up.
lore.spelunkery.wooden_channel: A wooden trough that carries water along it, and items floating in that water.
lore.spelunkery.stone_channel: A stone trough that carries water along it, and items floating in that water.
lore.spelunkery.sluice_grate: A grate that sifts through blocks washed over it by flowing water, picking out minerals and treasure. Different waters turn up different finds.
lore.spelunkery.spring_water_bucket: A bucket of Spring Water from the springs that bubble up in the mountains. Sluicing it turns up Niter.
lore.spelunkery.diamond_grindstone: A Grindstone coated in Diamond that polishes rough gems more efficiently. The coating wears off over time; restore it with a Rough Diamond Shard.
lore.spelunkery.compression_blast_miner: A heavy-duty mining machine that blasts out a large area of stone in front of it when fired.
lore.spelunkery.glowstick: A stick that glows when thrown or held. Dye it to change its colour.
lore.spelunkery.item_magnet: A magnet that pulls nearby items towards you while active. Use it to switch it on and off.
lore.spelunkery.tuning_fork: A fork that hums near Amethyst Geodes, vibrating faster as you get closer. Capture a Note Block's note by sneak-using it, then use it on another Note Block to copy the note. It can also direct Copper Golems.
lore.spelunkery.echo_fork: A fork made with Echo Shards that briefly highlights every living creature nearby.
lore.spelunkery.depth_gauge: A gauge that shows your current height in the world.
lore.spelunkery.stone_pebble: A small stone that can be thrown, or crafted back into Cobblestone.
lore.spelunkery.deepslate_pebble: A small piece of deepslate that can be thrown, or crafted back into Cobbled Deepslate.
lore.spelunkery.netherrack_pebble: A small piece of netherrack that can be thrown.
lore.spelunkery.magma_pebble: A hot little stone that can be thrown to set things alight.
lore.spelunkery.blackstone_pebble: A small piece of blackstone that can be thrown.
lore.spelunkery.basalt_pebble: A small piece of basalt that can be thrown.
lore.spelunkery.end_stone_pebble: A small piece of Esoterrock that can be thrown.
lore.spelunkery.coal_lump: A small piece of Coal. Burns in a Furnace for a short while.
lore.spelunkery.charcoal_lump: A small piece of Charcoal, also left behind by burnt food. Burns in a Furnace for a short while.
lore.spelunkery.raw_iron_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Iron dropped by Iron Ore. Nine make a Raw Iron.
lore.spelunkery.raw_copper_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Copper dropped by Copper Ore. Nine make a Raw Copper.
lore.spelunkery.raw_gold_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Gold dropped by Gold Ore. Nine make a Raw Gold.
lore.spelunkery.raw_tin_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Tin dropped by Deepslate Tin Ore. Nine make a Raw Tin.
lore.spelunkery.raw_lead_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Lead dropped by Deepslate and Nether Lead Ore. Nine make a Raw Lead.
lore.spelunkery.raw_silver_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Silver dropped by Deepslate and Soul Silver Ore, and by Silverfish. Nine make a Raw Silver.
lore.spelunkery.raw_bismuth_nugget: A small chunk of Raw Bismuth dropped by Nether Bismuth Ore. Nine make a Raw Bismuth.
lore.spelunkery.rough_diamond_shard: A rough piece of Diamond. Nine make a Rough Diamond.
lore.spelunkery.rough_diamond: An unpolished Diamond. Polish it on a Grindstone to reveal the gem.
lore.spelunkery.rough_cinnabar_shard: A rough piece of Cinnabar. Nine make a Rough Cinnabar.
lore.spelunkery.rough_cinnabar: Unpolished Cinnabar. Polish it on a Grindstone for Cinnabar Gems.
lore.spelunkery.rough_quartz_shard: A rough piece of Quartz. Can be crafted back into Quartz.
lore.spelunkery.cinnabar: A red gem polished from Rough Cinnabar. Used to make Item Magnets and Flux machinery.
lore.spelunkery.cinnabar_shard: A small piece of a Cinnabar Gem. Nine make a whole gem.
entity.spelunkery.dust_bunny.description: A tiny, timid ball of fluff that lives in caves.
